mapper.sql: WITH noticeType AS ( SELECT sys09_code noticeType_cd , sys09_name noticeType_nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'NoticeType' AND sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{c.companyId} END ), noticeDetail AS ( SELECT sys09_code noticeDetail_cd , sys09_name noticeDetail_nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'NoticeDetailCode' AND sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{c.companyId} END ) SELECT bbs02_notice.* , noticeType_nm AS bbs02_notice_type_nm , noticeDetail_nm AS bbs02_notice_detail_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(bbs02_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공개' ELSE '비공개' END AS bbs02_public_yn_nm FROM bbs02_notice LEFT OUTER JOIN bbs04_target_company ON ( bbs04_notice_id = bbs02_notice_id AND bbs04_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN noticeType ON noticeType_cd = bbs02_notice_type LEFT OUTER JOIN noticeDetail ON noticeDetail_cd = bbs02_notice_detail_cd WHERE ( bbs02_public_company_yn = 'true' OR bbs04_target_company IS NOT NULL ) AND bbs02_open_yn = '알림' AND bbs02_from_date <= f_today() AND bbs02_notice_type LIKE #{c.noticeType} AND bbs02_notice_detail_cd LIKE #{c.noticeDetailCode}
mapper.select:
